user.title: FreePBX Assist
user.description: Home Assistant will answer SIP calls from your FreePBX on the port below. Point a custom PJSIP endpoint at this machine (see the README).

data.pbx_host: FreePBX IP address (optional; only accept calls from this address)
FreePBX IP address (optional; only accept calls from this address)
data.allowed_extensions: Allowed extensions (comma separated; empty = allow all)
data.pipeline_map: Per-extension pipelines, one per line: extension = pipeline name
data.pipeline_timeout: Seconds to wait for a spoken command before hanging up
data.rtp_port: RTP audio port (UDP; 0 = random per call; set a fixed port if the PBX reaches Home Assistant through a router/NAT)
